displayName: PAGE — Prod worker /health not healthy (body assertion)

documentation.content:
The prod worker's /health endpoint stopped returning a body containing "status":"healthy" for ~3 consecutive minutes.

WHY BODY AND NOT STATUS CODE: on 2026-08-11 /health returned HTTP 200 with a "degraded" body for 11m39s while /api/v1/verify served service_unavailable, and nothing noticed. A 200-only uptime check is blind to exactly this failure.

TRIAGE:
1. curl https://arkova-worker-270018525501.us-central1.run.app/health -- read checks.database / checks.anchoring / checks.kms to see which subsystem is down.
2. If checks.database is not ok, check for a PostgREST schema-cache failure (see the PGRST002 alert) and for blocked DDL on hot public tables.
3. Check Cloud Run revision health and recent deploys.
